description: Default desktop capability for every app window: the main window, the dictation pill, the meeting-detection popup, and the recording indicator. All load local app content and need core IPC (event listen/emit, window drag regions). A window missing from this list gets core plugin commands DENIED per-window by the ACL -- e.g. `listen()` from @tauri-apps/api/event (which is invoke("plugin:event|listen") under the hood) rejects, while app-defined commands still work, which looks like events silently never arriving.
